How to use
  • 1
    Click the extension icon — or right-click → Read aloud
    Click the AudiTex icon in your toolbar to read the full page, or right-click and select “Read aloud with AudiTex” to read a selection or the whole page.
  • 2
    Control playback from the floating widget
    Pause, seek, change voice, or adjust speed using the circle widget that appears on the page. Hover to reveal the radial menu.
  • 3
    Read Only mode — highlight without audio
    Click “Read Only” in the widget to switch to silent reading mode. Sentences are highlighted at your chosen reading pace (WPM). Your mode and position are saved, so it picks up where you left off on every page.
  • 4
    Turbo mode — ~2× faster generation
    The Turbo button in the widget runs two AI models in parallel, cutting the time between sentences roughly in half. It’s on by default — toggle it off any time if you need to conserve memory.
Privacy
100% on-device — your text never leaves your browser. The AI model runs entirely on your machine. No account, no server, no data collection.
